name: @ocean-xyz/ocean-mdk-worker
description: MDK worker plugin for the Ocean.xyz mining pool. Loaded from this directory by WorkerRuntimeV2; it exports no module of its own.
author: Ocean

scripts.test: npm run setup:mdk && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.validate: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const c=require('./mdk-contract.json'); const names=new Set(); for (const e of c.capabilities.telemetry) { if (names.has(e.name)) throw new Error('duplicate '+e.name); names.add(e.name); if (!fs.existsSync(e.handler)) throw new Error('missing '+e.handler) } if (c.capabilities.telemetry.some(e => e.name==='health' && e.handler!=='src/telemetry/health.js')) throw new Error('health override missing'); console.log('contract ok', names.size)"
scripts.setup:mdk: npm --prefix node_modules/@tetherto/mdk install -w backend/core/mdk-worker -w backend/core/kernel -w backend/core/client -w backend/core/mdk --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund
